notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
description:
Activate up to fiva mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
Repeat.
